requested_order.text: Wegovy (semaglutide) 0.25 mg SC once weekly x4 weeks, then titrate per label to 2.4 mg weekly

weight_management_program.text:
A/P:
1. Overweight, BMI 29.0, with hyperlipidemia — start today:
 - Calorie tracking app, target ~1800 kcal/day; no eating after 9 PM; takeout limited to weekends.
 - Walking about 30 minutes 4 days a week (campus loop).
 - Referred to a dietitian-led weight management program; RD intake scheduled.
 Follow-up in ~3 months.
2. Hyperlipidemia on atorvastatin 20 mg daily; last LDL 153. Continue; recheck after lifestyle changes.
3. Migraine — stable, sumatriptan PRN.

NUTRITION CONSULT — INITIAL
Date: 10/27/2025
Dietitian-led weight management program intake. Food log: skips breakfast, large late dinner/takeout, snacks while studying 10 PM–1 AM (chips, candy, energy drinks).
Plan: calorie tracking at ~1800 kcal/day; breakfast within 2 h of waking; pre-portioned study snacks (fruit, popcorn); cut energy drinks; takeout on weekends only.
Activity: walking ~30 min 4 days/week, as set with PCP.
RD follow-up monthly x3, then every 2–3 months.

NUTRITION FOLLOW-UP
Date: 04/29/2026
Reviewed food log: adherent most days, averaging ~1800 kcal. Late-night snacking mostly replaced with planned snacks.
Adjustments: more protein at breakfast; portion down pasta at dinner; plan for conference travel next month.
Reports keeping up with walking 4 days/week.
Next RD visit in ~2 months.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/14/2026
S: Follow-up weight and lipids. Continues the diet and exercise plan and RD follow-ups since October. Tracking, walking 4 days/week. Frustrated — weight 83.1 kg today vs 85.9 kg when she started in October (-3.3%), no further change the last few months despite adherence. Asks about medication. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis. Using condoms + OCP; not planning pregnancy — counseled to stop medication 2 months before trying to conceive.
O: Wt 83.1 kg, BMI 28.1. BP 125/72.

A/P:
1. Overweight (BMI 28.1) with hyperlipidemia — plateau despite lifestyle program. Start semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly (Wegovy) with standard dose titration; counsel on GI side effects, hydration, and smaller meals. Continue lifestyle plan. Recheck in 3 months.
2. Hyperlipidemia on atorvastatin 20 mg daily; last LDL 153. Repeat fasting lipids.

LAB RESULT NOTE — 05/29/2025
Fasting lipid panel reviewed: LDL 153, HDL 45, TG 182 mg/dL. Total cholesterol 234. Patient reports she fasted ~8 h rather than 10–12 h; TG may be mildly overstated. For future draws, fast 10–12 h (water OK).
LDL remains elevated on atorvastatin; adherence confirmed. Will discuss at next PCP visit.

PHARMACIST MEDICATION REVIEW — 06/30/2026
Reviewed OTC supplements pt wants to bring on trip: melatonin, probiotic, ginger chews, and a "hair, skin, nails" biotin supplement. No interactions with atorvastatin, sertraline, omeprazole, sumatriptan. Advised that high-dose biotin can interfere with some lab tests — stop 3 days before bloodwork. Pt understood.
